about_the_game:
About This Demo

This demo showcases 20% of the full game content. The complete game consists of 10 chapters, each representing one in-game day. In this demo, players can experience the full story and gameplay of the first two days, with an approximate playtime of 60 minutes.

Gameplay

Players interact with NPCs in the game by composing different pieces of music through the selection of chords, rhythms, and emotions.

Each NPC has their own musical preferences.

Different musical compositions will lead to different interactions and potential outcomes with each character. (Endings are not included in this demo.)

Background Story

With the advancement of interstellar jump technology, intelligent life forms across the universe have long enjoyed the convenience and freedom of space travel. Frequent exchanges and trade among civilizations have given rise to a brilliant yet absurd universe.

On December 22, 2999, the Dutaffians, having spent a fortune to purchase ownership of Earth from humans, are about to take full control of the blue planet and begin its process of “primitivization.” As Earth faces the removal of all human-made technologies, space radio host Z must prepare to shut down their broadcasting station.

Characters in the Game

In the final 10 days before Z’s space radio station goes silent, a diverse array of listeners—including space pirates, cosmic morticians, interstellar racers, space poets, bounty hunters, and galactic scavengers—tune in one after another. Amid the melodies, they share curious tales from across the galaxy and reveal the stories of their own lives…
